name: VeriWorkly Studio Agent Card
description: VeriWorkly Studio (app.veriworkly.com) is the core authenticated workspace and local-first editor for ATS-optimized resumes, cover letters, Master Profile data management, AI writing tools, and API key issuance.

api.auth_details: Web sessions authenticate via Better Auth Email OTP cookies ('veriworkly-auth.session_token' in development or '__Secure-veriworkly-auth.session_token' in production). Programmatic agents authenticate via hashed Bearer tokens ('Authorization: Bearer vw_...').

services.name: Document Builder & Canvas
services.description: Interactive, pixel-accurate resume and cover letter builder with live paged PDF preview and template switching.

services.name: Master Profile Store
services.description: Central canonical JSON profile holding complete career history to seed new documents and web portfolios.

services.name: ATS Checker Workspace
services.description: Deterministic ATS readiness scanner and AI-assisted deep analysis against job descriptions.

services.name: Developer API Key Management
services.description: Self-serve API key creation, scope delegation, secret rotation, and revocation.

services.name: Credits & Wallet Ledger
services.description: AI credit wallet balance, FIFO grant allocation details, and complete usage history.

services.name: Affiliate & Ambassador Dashboards
services.description: Referral tracking, 3-tier commission management, and campus ambassador application tracking.

capabilities.name: Document Management
capabilities.description: Create, edit, list, tags, duplicate, and soft-delete resume and cover letter documents.

capabilities.name: Master Profile CRUD
capabilities.description: Read and update central Master Profile to auto-populate documents.

capabilities.name: ATS Scanning & Analysis
capabilities.description: Run deterministic ATS readiness rules and AI job-description keyword match analysis.

capabilities.name: AI Content Generation
capabilities.description: Execute AI-powered resume tailoring, bullet point generation, and cover letter drafting.

capabilities.name: GitHub & LinkedIn Ingestion
capabilities.description: OAuth GitHub import (up to 30 repos) and AI-parsed LinkedIn text extraction.

capabilities.name: Document Sharing
capabilities.description: Mint, password-protect, and revoke public document share links.

capabilities.name: Developer API Keys
capabilities.description: Generate, rotate, and revoke API keys with scope control.

compliance.data_storage: Local-first by default in browser localStorage, optional background cloud sync to PostgreSQL.
